parts:
Hehe... I'm a masochist...
An utter masochist...

You... missed?
Are you teasing me?

Didn't hurt.
That's why I defended.
How do you like my trap?

Where am I? Who am I?
...Oh, right. I don't have a name...
What?! It means nothing if you miss!
My life's not worth a thing...

Huh, I missed?
Man, that's embarrassing.
Beat me? Try again in a century!

Close... but that's a gap
you'll never bridge.

Huh? Wanted me to go easy?
Should've said so from the start.
Tch... What a mess this is.
Heh... This should be a fun fight.
...It was all an illusion... Heh heh...
Laugh... Go on, laugh... Heh... Heh heh...
I don't give a damn anymore...
Pretty clean for a guy who doesn't wash his hands after a piss...
No... Some things won't come clean, no matter how much you wash... No...
Not pretty... If you're going to attack, at least hit me.
Whoa?! Right... I was guarding. You startled me...
Get a taste of the space pirates' mechanical weapons!
My life's not worth a thing...

Huh, I missed?
Man, that's embarrassing.
Beat me? Try again in a century!

Close... but that's a gap
you'll never bridge.

Huh? Wanted me to go easy?
Should've said so from the start.
My life's not worth a thing...

Huh, I missed?
Man, that's embarrassing.
Beat me? Try again in a century!

Close... but that's a gap
you'll never bridge.

Till this body gives out,
I'll keep living with my head high!

Gwaaagh!
K-knew I couldn't do it...

Yeah. I'm Madao...
A totally useless old guy...

Nice! Good miss!
This old guy approves!

Even an old guy
can defend himself.

Very well...
We shall indulge you a little.

I-I'm a prince...
A prince, I say... A prince...

You missed!
You can't hit me!
Such science! Can you match it?

Did you do something?
Didn't notice.

Sorry. The Shinsengumi
can't waste all day
on you.
Hmph... I'll teach you a lesson!

The world never changes...
It's all pointless...
Utterly pointless...

Whoa! You idiot!
What if that had hit me?!

One of my own inventions...
Enjoying yourself?
Sheesh... What a waste of time.

Ugh, I can't deal with this.
Why do I have to put up
with all this crap?

What, didn't you see
I was blocking?

Papi... Mommy...
I am so tired...

Misses get you nowhere.
Not that a hit would hurt.
How do you like this gadget?!

The nation... Heh...
Who cares anymore...

A perfect chance...
Time to get serious!

I'm just a gorilla...
That's all anyone sees...
Sob...

Close one...
Good thing I guarded...

That's Gengai's gadget
for you... Close call!

Kuriko... Dad's done for...
I just don't care anymore.

Hey, I'm over here.
Try aiming properly.

Reborn through superscience!
I can't lose to the likes of you!

How ugly... If you're
going to attack,
at least hit me.

Whoa?! Oh, right...
I was blocking...
Startled myself there...

A contraption is
more than enough for you...

How ugly... If you're
going to attack,
at least hit me.

Whoa?! Oh, right...
I was blocking...
Startled myself there...

A contraption is
more than enough for you...

Ahh... Lost all motivation.
Don't care anymore.
Do whatever you like.
How is that for a gadget?!

Hopeless! A sword dojo,
in this day and age...
Sob... sob...

Huh? You can't see?
Poor thing... Now's my chance.

Testing my defense?
See how pointless that was?
Ahh... This is starting to feel stupid...
Where are you aiming? Get serious!
If we're doing this, let's have fun!

Ouch... Wait, no?
Huh? Missed? Lucky!

Dad... Covered in oil...
Happily tinkering... Machines...
I liked... you... that way...

A drag queen must be
stronger than anyone...
Is that asking too much...?

Too bad!
Aim better next time...

How's that defense?
A drag queen's guard is ironclad!

A drag queen can handle
a contraption too!
I-I'm just not cut out for this...?!

Heh... in the end,
I'm just a boring pair of glasses...

What a spectacular miss...
Want to borrow my glasses?

Behold! Glasses defense!
...Not that glasses help.

I'll destroy all till
the beast falls silent.

Thought I'd forgotten
how to sweat.
Guess I was wrong.

Heh... I'll just destroy it.
This rotten world...
...Seriously, what am I supposed to do...?

Sorry... Worst blunder
of my life.

Hehe... I'm a nobody
whose only trait
is minton...

Um... Can you see me?
No?! Too plain to notice?!
Let's try a Gin Tama battle.

Is my explanation
just meddling to you?
Oh, is that so? My mistake.
Just don't get too full of yourself.

Listen up.
Let's start with the battle screen.

Look at the top of the screen.
See the gauges beside
the face icons?

Yours are on the left.
Your opponent's are on the right.
Mine, for now.

The top one is Health.
The bottom one is Spirit.

And mental attacks
reduce your Spirit.

Here's the important part.
If either gauge runs out,
you lose.

Which gives out first,
your body or your nerve?
That's about the size of it.
Well? Got all that so far?

Brawl, Kotodama, Effect.
Three Gin Tama kinds,
with attack and defense types.

These are Brawl Gin Tama
for attacking.

Touch one of the three icons
on the left of the bottom screen
to switch Gin Tama types.

These are on loan for now.
Try the icons and check
all three Gin Tama types.

Hey, slow down!
One thing at a time!

First, check all
the Gin Tama types.

Attack-type Brawl Gin Tama
deal physical damage.

Throw them or strike with them
to take away your foe's Health.

They can reduce damage
or restore your Health.

Attack-type Kotodama Gin Tama
deal mental damage.

Hit a sore spot with words,
and even a tough opponent
can go down easily.

Finding someone's weak spot
is the tricky part.

Watch people. Talk to them.
Information is vital.

They reduce mental damage
or restore your Spirit.
Effect Gin Tama are for strategy.

They boost attack or defense,
add extra hits...
Some work as traps.
Well? Got all that so far?

Now, last of all,
let's cover set Gin Tama.

Some Gin Tama take effect
as soon as you use them...

Others stay set on the field
until their conditions are met.

See? Gin, you can't tell
which Gin Tama I've set, can you?
That's the fun of setting them.

Now try attacking me
with a Brawl Gin Tama.

I said a Brawl Gin Tama!
Keep being contrary
and we'll be here all day.

That was a Counter Gin Tama.
It activates in response
to a physical attack.

In a real fight, keep an eye
on the Gin Tama your foe has set.

Some Gin Tama remove set ones
or avoid their effects altogether.
Make good use of them.

Ready for a real battle?
They say you learn by doing.

Brawl Gin Tama and some Effect
Gin Tama are consumed when used.

Don't waste them, or you'll
run out before you know it.
Not a good look.

Still, if you run out
of Brawl Gin Tama during battle...

Bonus Gin Tama will appear.
You won't be left empty-handed.

Bonus Gin Tama appear
near the middle of your list.
They're just that: a bonus.

They vanish after the battle.
Use them while you can.
Get your money's worth.

Let's have ourselves
a Gin Tama battle!

You should be able to handle
the crowd around here.

Not that I can picture you
losing an argument, Gin...

You won't get far with a tiny
collection. Don't slack off
on hunting Gin Tama.

They say there are rare ones
even I've never heard of...

Kotodama Boost makes
Kotodama hits stronger...

And Character Gin Tama
that can summon your allies.

I'd like to give them a try
myself, if I get the chance...

But whatever you do,
relax and enjoy yourself.
That's the best way to play.

I didn't lend you much,
so I suppose that's about
right for a beginner...

You might just stumble
on a rare Gin Tama that way.

Kotodama Boost makes
Kotodama hits stronger...

And Character Gin Tama
that can summon your allies.

I'd like to give them a try
myself, if I get the chance...

But whatever you do,
relax and enjoy yourself.
That's the best way to play.
This is why I hate it...

Ow! A squeaky hammer
is good enough for me!?

Gah!? That gun...
The legendary Sweeper
used it...!?

I'll show you a real
Soul Reaper!

Guh...! That sword...
Only a Soul Reaper
can wield that...!?

Ow...!
Is that a dango skewer...?

Ugh! That stinks!
Like a rag used to
wipe up milk!

Ugh! Wait a second!
Was that egg rotten...!?

Waaaah!? My eyesight
is getting worse AGAIN!?

I'll take a little
of your blood.
